run.environment: pinned flake devShell (nix print-dev-env .#default) on a clean checkout of tested_commit

tests.observes: Typed emission: the invoked bound operation imports exactly noble/test_code_export_bound (i32) -> i32 and calls it with slot 9 only; the test.emit import is absent; a forged empty effect row is Invalid before emission.

Real Wasmtime execution of the compiled ledger@1.capture fixture: with a host import that returns 0 and with one that traps, the host sees exactly one request carrying only slot 9 and the invocation's $failure stays at terminal code 5.

A pure checked Program compiles through the worker-program own<program> ABI; the checked ledger@1.capture Program is refused by the test.emit selection, its latent code-export effect stays noncallable through programs.admit run, and only the request-code-export guest compiles without granting a direct effect.
Kernel registration refuses mismatched code-export adapter rows as InvalidRepresentation, admits the exact row as Behavior::BoundCodeExport(9) and refuses a forged effect row.
Source checking yields the code-export I64 endomorphism interface (not the test.emit one) and refuses the source when the host-selected adapter binding is absent.

The checked I64 -- I64 ! test.code-export interface is refused by the pure and test.emit selections; the code-export selection's request-code-export import takes own<program> and a string and returns a boolean; the effect is known but its witness grants no import authority.

Real installed guest: the WIT export request is denied at export authorization with 1 guest request, 0 protected operations, no capture publication and a recorded denial; the private Text never appears in the report; the source-bound Core invocation is denied.

The noble worker program test-host child runs the compiled guest: the WIT owner request and the Core bound effect are separately denied (core_requests 1, core_denials 1, protected_operations 0, completed_invocations 0, capture_published false) and stdout/stderr never contain the private markers.

non_claims: WORKER-12 stays implementation absent, execution not-run, proof open and trust unassessed: this receipt covers the adapter slice, not the case's independent component scenario.
